principle: Runtime enforcement plus adversarial evidence, not documentation, is the proof.

invariants.name: authenticated_not_authorized
invariants.enforcement: sensitive route/application permission guards
invariants.negative_test: authenticated actor without required permission is denied

invariants.name: foreign_object_denied
invariants.enforcement: resource owner scope on commercial_action/order/repeat_order and sensitive reads via ResourceReadAuthorizer
invariants.negative_test: actor with valid permission cannot act on or read a foreign resource

invariants.name: public_intake_outbox_stale_worker_denied
invariants.enforcement: public-intake outbox publication requires current worker lease
invariants.negative_test: a stale public-intake outbox worker cannot mark a reclaimed event published

invariants.name: provider_rollback_stale_activation_denied
invariants.enforcement: provider activation rollback uses compare-and-set on the currently active activation version and activation timestamp
invariants.negative_test: a rollback command based on a prior activation cannot disable a provider that was reactivated after the command read state

invariants.name: stale_provider_binding_denied
invariants.enforcement: provider instances are bound to the exact canonical activation version and activation timestamp; cached instances are invalidated before traffic
invariants.negative_test: a provider object from a prior activation cannot execute traffic after canonical rollback and reactivation, even when configuration and activation version are reused

invariants.name: stale_local_activation_state_cannot_block_reactivation
invariants.enforcement: activation admission is decided from canonical shared activation state, not an old process-local enabled flag
invariants.negative_test: a replica with stale local enabled state can reactivate after another replica has performed a canonical rollback

invariants.name: counterparty_monitoring_actor_scope_and_integrity
invariants.enforcement: counterparty monitoring/favorites require explicit permissions, are scoped to actor_id, and observations are bound to the subscribed identifier with hashed provenance
invariants.negative_test: an actor without the capability or outside the subscription owner cannot read/write the monitoring resource; tampered snapshot payloads and invalid identifiers are rejected

invariants.name: stale_worker_cannot_overwrite_newer_send
invariants.enforcement: lease-guarded atomic external-effect unknown transition
invariants.negative_test: a worker that lost its send lease cannot move a newer worker's SENDING action to FAILED

invariants.name: permission_non_escalation
invariants.enforcement: explicit Permission membership with no derived or wildcard capabilities
invariants.negative_test: an actor holding arbitrary permission combinations cannot satisfy an ungranted third permission

invariants.name: client_evidence_not_authoritative
invariants.enforcement: server-side authoritative lookup
invariants.negative_test: client-submitted canonical evidence fields rejected

invariants.name: public_identity_not_client_defined
invariants.enforcement: trusted peer identity
invariants.negative_test: rotating client header does not reset budget

invariants.name: bot_verification_server_side
invariants.enforcement: BotChallengeVerifier composition boundary
invariants.negative_test: spoofed 'passed' header without verifier rejected

invariants.name: bounded_http_body
invariants.enforcement: RequestBodySizeLimitMiddleware
invariants.negative_test: oversized body rejected

invariants.name: outbound_destination_pinned
invariants.enforcement: official host allowlists
invariants.negative_test: attacker HTTPS endpoint rejected

invariants.name: redirect_not_followed
invariants.enforcement: secure_urlopen
invariants.negative_test: 30x redirect does not trigger second request

invariants.name: server_correlation
invariants.enforcement: CorrelationMiddleware generates IDs
invariants.negative_test: client correlation header cannot replace canonical ID

invariants.name: critical_effect_idempotent
invariants.enforcement: durable idempotency reservation
invariants.negative_test: same key converges; different payload fails

invariants.name: outbox_lease_safe
invariants.enforcement: PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED leases
invariants.negative_test: two workers cannot claim one event concurrently

invariants.name: frozen_kernel_integrity
invariants.enforcement: kernel hash gate
invariants.negative_test: kernel byte drift blocks promotion

invariants.name: minimal_public_health
invariants.enforcement: readiness returns only ready
invariants.negative_test: provider topology absent from unauthenticated response

invariants.name: fail_closed_composition
invariants.enforcement: required public security dependencies validated at composition time
invariants.negative_test: missing allowlist/verifier prevents insecure public runtime composition

invariants.name: counterparty_monitoring_checkpoint_recovery_integrity
invariants.enforcement: daily monitoring uses durable batch/item checkpoints, bounded leases with worker ownership CAS, deterministic command idempotency and fail-closed provider/snapshot handling
invariants.negative_test: a stale worker cannot complete a reclaimed item; provider outage creates no snapshot/change; replay converges to the existing snapshot; exhausted attempts do not call the provider; tampered snapshots are rejected

invariants.name: web_operator_client_cannot_be_business_authority
invariants.enforcement: Web shell and assets are public, while all business state access remains behind canonical authenticated APIs; browser storage does not persist operator credentials
invariants.negative_test: unauthenticated requests can fetch only shell/assets/public intake; protected operator APIs reject absent authentication; client source contains no direct database access and no persistent operator token storage

invariants.name: repeat_order_capability_requires_real_revalidator
invariants.enforcement: Repeat-order Web/API capability is advertised only when a server-composed RepeatOrderService exists; that service requires a RepeatOrderRevalidator and validates counterparty, service scope, pricing, date/capacity and evidence freshness before creating or confirming repeat orders
invariants.negative_test: without composed RepeatOrderService the capability is false and repeat UI/API fails closed; client JavaScript contains no alternate business validation or local repeat-order state store

invariants.name: phase4_global_acceptance_surface_integrity
invariants.enforcement: All public, MAX and operator surfaces are same-origin Web surfaces over canonical APIs; protected APIs fail closed without authentication; browser security headers are applied at the outermost HTTP boundary; client-side code cannot persist or originate business truth
invariants.negative_test: global acceptance tests assert public shell availability, protected endpoint rejection, security headers on both success and auth-failure responses, absence of browser persistence/database access in client code, and presence of all required operator surfaces

invariants.name: pwa_offline_layer_cannot_be_business_authority
invariants.enforcement: service worker caches public shell/assets only; business APIs and protected operator state are network-only; pending mutations are bounded in page memory and require durable idempotency keys
invariants.negative_test: service worker/network tests prove /v1/* and protected state are never cached, queued entries have no Authorization header and no persistent browser storage is used

closure.P1: fix or explicit bounded scheduled disposition
